{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the four sites
print("Unique sites:", trial_df['site'].unique())

# Check if the number of sites is actually four
site_count = trial_df['site'].nunique()
print("Number of unique sites:", site_count)

# Calculate response rate per site: (number of responded == 1) / total per site
response_rate_by_site = trial_df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()

# Display response rates
print("\nResponse rates by site:")
print(response_rate_by_site)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
highest_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
highest_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

print(f"\nSite with highest response rate: {highest_site} ({highest_rate:.3f})")"}
